question: Three inflows combine at a pumping station. The flows and concentrations are 60 L/s at 150 mg/L, 40 L/s at 250 mg/L, and 50 L/s at 190 mg/L. What is the flow weighted concentration of the combined flow? Round to 0 decimal places.
